title: Singapore Air Show 2026
description: My first air show, photographed with a Nikon Z6III and a Tamron 150–600mm G2. Close formations give way to smoke trails and a final burst of colour.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.56.jpeg.title: In formation
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.56.jpeg.caption: Two red aircraft hold their lines against blue sky and cloud, each leaving a thin trail of smoke.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.56.jpeg.alt: Two red-and-white propeller aircraft fly one above the other, trailing white smoke against blue sky and clouds.

photo_2026-10-06 17.55.03.jpeg.title: Shared airspace
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.03.jpeg.caption: A helicopter and a fighter jet share the frame. Their different shapes stand out against the pale sky.
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.03.jpeg.alt: A dark military helicopter flies below a grey fighter jet, with a blue smoke trail extending behind them.

photo_2026-10-06 17.55.00.jpeg.title: Arcs in the sky
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.00.jpeg.caption: White trails curve behind a helicopter and spread across the blue sky.
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.00.jpeg.alt: A helicopter flies beside a fan of curling white trails, with scattered clouds below.

photo_2026-10-06 17.55.08.jpeg.title: A final burst of colour
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.08.jpeg.caption: Three helicopters separate across the sky. Red and white trails make a bright ending to the gallery.
photo_2026-10-06 17.55.08.jpeg.alt: Three helicopters fly apart, with one above the others and red and white smoke trails extending down the frame.
